risk_rationale: Public marketing/portfolio site, static export, no auth, no persistence, no user input, no third-party script execution; blast radius of failure is content display only. Deployment is an owner-authorized publish of an immutable export with instant rollback to the previous release.

testing.note: 31/31 browser checks across 2 routes x 3 viewports + 5 UAT journeys; 13/13 unit subtests; 100% surface coverage reconciled.

security.note: npm audit 0 advisories; secrets sweep clean; CSP/HSTS/frame-deny/nosniff headers shipped with export; injection surface nil (no input, no API).

performance.note: Measured FCP 140ms (home desktop), transfer 90,710B, total bundle 298,700B gzipped — within budget; self-hosted fonts, lazy below-fold media, static export with no server round-trips.

observability.note: Static hosting has no server logs; compensating controls verified pre-freeze: runtime startup clean (HTTP 200, 0 errors) and browser console clean (0 errors/warnings/network failures over 6 page-viewport checks). Post-publish monitoring is host analytics (PV/UV) via the publishing platform.

deployment.note: Artifact is the validated immutable `out/` static export plus _headers; deploy = publish release of this export; no runtime config, no env vars consumed; build reproducibility proven by green lint/tsc/build runs.

rollback.note: Rollback = re-publish previous release (prior export remains intact and was the live site before publish); source rollback = git revert of the feature branch merge. Never destructive to content data — all copy is version-controlled in git.

open_items_non_blocking: QR-004: footer year is build-time frozen — refresh at each publish or move to runtime-independent copy (Phase 7 follow-up).
QR-005: stale fact-whitelist entries for removed features — prune with next content change.
QR-003: /404 recorded as HTTP 200 (styled not-found page under static export convention) — host should serve real 404 status via its notFound configuration.
summary: All six production-readiness controls evidenced for a low-risk static site; independent quality review passed with zero blocking findings; publication deferred to explicit owner authorization.
